per_type.tn_note: Not computed. The approved evaluation design (validation_strategy.md Sec22) defines TP/FP/FN/precision/recall/F1 only - it does not define a valid negative population for any anomaly type. The natural candidate population for each type (e.g. every Interview/Offer/Application row) is dominated by rows that were never at risk of that specific anomaly, so treating them as confirmed negatives would invent an unapproved denominator and produce a misleading, inflated accuracy-like figure rather than a reliable metric.
